title: Wholemeal pasta with turnips, sage and walnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or staple: pasta, turnips, cavolo nero, butter, garlic, walnuts, hard cheese, sage and lemon.

supermarket.reason: Wholemeal penne, turnips, cavolo nero, walnuts and vegetarian hard cheese are everyday items at Tesco and similar shops.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large pan, a frying pan and a grater, with simple boiling and frying.

works.reason: 350g pasta with 500g turnips, greens, cheese and nuts is right for four, and the timings and the pasta water for the sauce are sensible.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and dicing 500g of turnips, stripping the cavolo nero, slicing the garlic and grating the cheese fits in about 15 minutes, and the 15-minute cook matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Wholemeal penne is a fair name for dried pasta, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including sage, chilli and lemon, is used in the steps with nothing extra.

seasonal_feel.reason: Buttery fried turnips with sage and walnuts make a warming mid-February dinner, and the turnips are the centre of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family pasta made with wholemeal pasta, two vegetables, nuts and cheese.
